title: Evening Edition — November 6, 2026
subtitle: 10 made-up stories for layout and publishing tests.
intro: This is a sandbox edition generated by scripts/sandbox.mjs. Outlets, towns and people are fictional, links go to example.com, and photos are random placeholders.

stories.headline: Tech employer to add 600 jobs at new North Ridge campus
stories.summary: Cloud software company Lattice & Pine says it will build a regional campus in North Ridge and hire 600 people over three years. The state approved $12 million in performance-based tax credits tied to the hiring.

stories.headline: Brewery wins national gold medal for its winter ale
stories.summary: High Desert Brewing took gold at a national beer competition for its spiced winter ale. The small brewery says it will double production of the seasonal beer this year.

stories.headline: Mural festival transforms downtown alleys
stories.summary: More than 30 artists painted murals across 12 downtown alleys during the weeklong Walls of Granite festival. Organizers expect the new artwork to draw visitors through the winter.

stories.headline: Amateur astronomers spot rare double comet from local observatory
stories.summary: Volunteers at the Pine Hollow Observatory photographed a comet that appears to have split into two fragments. Researchers at the state university are using the images to study how comets break apart near the sun.

stories.headline: Home sales slow while prices hold steady
stories.summary: Home sales across the metro area fell 9 percent from a year ago in October, but the median sale price held at about $585,000. Agents say buyers are waiting for mortgage rates to ease further.

stories.headline: Ski areas move up opening day after cold snap
stories.summary: Two high-elevation ski areas say they will open this weekend, a week earlier than planned, after snowmaking crews took advantage of overnight lows in the teens. Only a handful of beginner runs will be open at first.

stories.headline: Regional grocer Copper Basket to open three new stores
stories.summary: Copper Basket, a family-owned grocery chain, says it will open stores in Aspen Flats, Redwater and North Ridge over the next 18 months. The company plans to hire about 400 people and expand its locally sourced produce program.

stories.headline: Mayor proposes budget with new money for parks and transit
stories.summary: Mayor Elena Park's proposed $2.1 billion budget adds 40 park rangers, extends weekend bus service and freezes most fees. The council will hold three public hearings before a final vote next month.

stories.headline: Wildfire crews contain grass fire near Redwater
stories.summary: Firefighters fully contained a 340-acre grass fire east of Redwater on Sunday afternoon. No structures were lost, and evacuation orders for about 120 homes have been lifted.

stories.headline: Mountaineers rally late to clinch division title
stories.summary: Down by 10 with six minutes left, the Silver Creek Mountaineers scored two touchdowns to win 31-27 and secure their first division title in a decade. Quarterback Dana Ruiz threw for 312 yards and ran in the winning score.
